name: Playwright CLI
description: Installs Playwright CLI (@playwright/cli) globally via npm. Supports Ubuntu/Debian, Alpine, RHEL/Fedora/CentOS and other Linux distributions.

version.description: Version of @playwright/cli to install (e.g. 'latest', '0.1.17'). Passed directly to 'npm install -g'.

installSkills.description: Run 'playwright-cli install --skills' after installation to install Playwright skills for coding agents.
